Common Inquiries

Frequently Asked Questions

What is the difference between 1:1 Mentorship and Group Training?

In 1:1 Mentorship, sessions are conducted privately with personalized pacing, custom business case reviews, and direct mentor attention to your specific ad campaigns. Group cohorts follow structured weekly schedules with collaborative peer interactions and group doubt clearing.

Do I get to run campaigns on real ad accounts?

Yes. Our philosophy is 100% practical. You will set up real Business Managers, configure Meta and Google conversion tracking, construct audiences, and optimize real campaigns instead of working solely on mock setups.

Are the courses suitable for beginners or experienced marketers?

We offer curricula that begin with core fundamentals and advance to complex attribution, scaling strategies, and multi-channel performance marketing suitable for business owners, agency freelancers, and aspiring marketers.

How does admission work?

Since cohort seats and 1:1 mentorship slots are strictly capped for personalized quality, admission is confirmed via a preliminary WhatsApp discussion where we evaluate your goals and ensure alignment with the curriculum.
